const resumeText = $json.text || $json.content || $json.extractedText || JSON.stringify($json);
const cleanResume = String(resumeText).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 12000);
const prompt = `
You are a job-search assistant.
Analyze the following resume text and return ONLY valid JSON.
Do not wrap in markdown. Do not include explanations. Do not include company names.
Return JSON in exactly this format:
{
  "target_roles": ["role1", "role2", "role3"],
  "skills": ["skill1", "skill2", "skill3"],
  "search_keywords": ["keyword1", "keyword2", "keyword3"],
  "internship_keywords": ["keyword1", "keyword2", "keyword3"]
}
Rules:
- target_roles should be realistic entry-level roles based on the resume
- skills should be technical skills/tools only
- search_keywords should help search for jobs
- internship_keywords should help search for internships
- keep each list concise and relevant
- no duplicate items
Resume:
${cleanResume}
`;
return [{ json: { prompt, resumeText: cleanResume } }];

const seen = new Set();
return $input.all().filter(i => { if (!i.json.url) return false; if (seen.has(i.json.url)) return false; seen.add(i.json.url); return true; });
